title: Duplicate CSV headers changed the result
detail: The historic Position parser accepts a duplicate force column; a scaled duplicate changes inferred mobility while coherence can remain high. Current admission rejects ambiguous/duplicate headers.

title: Force and voltage were not one channel
detail: Current traces require explicit force_N and matching units. Voltage-to-force conversion is not implemented and is rejected.

title: Invalid inputs could reuse a previous result
detail: The integrated interface must block export/bridging after invalid or unapplied changes. Archived interfaces retain their known behavior.

title: Standalone tests depended on a missing directory
detail: Current acquisition tests do not write a frozen research receipt; extracted source instructions are verified separately.

title: Six source pointers were unresolved
detail: The integrated graph resolves every evidence pointer and retains source-version observations through conservative deduplication. A project inference is not primary evidence.

title: Selected modes are not the entire spectrum
detail: Radial families omit nonradial/torsional, rigid, seam, anisotropic and real fixture modes. The finite contact and sine-basis diagnostic models are declared reductions.

title: Thin-shell accuracy is conditional
detail: The default membrane and full radial shell models differ by about0.4066Hz. This model discrepancy is not a measured specimen calibration or automatically independent A/B noise.

title: Candidate peaks are not fitted poles
detail: The offline analyzer returns candidate spectral peaks; the browser uses known synthetic frequencies. A preregistered fitted same-mode estimate remains necessary for a real block trial.

title: Full rank is not global or physical uniqueness
detail: Temporal observability, drive reachability, nuisance estimability and global aliases answer different questions. Rank does not certify a complete apparatus model or absence of noise.

title: A/B balance does not eliminate confounding
detail: ABBA assumptions, serial dependence, mode selection, covariance, power and missingness must be declared. Locked temperature/preload cannot be separated by repeating the same design.

title: Hosted Gateway site inaccessible
detail: gatewayresearch.kimi.page returned access errors/HTTP403. Repository promises cannot substitute for inspecting that site.

title: Originals and media absent from pinned repo
detail: A manifest is not a verified binary; the1977 cleaned transcript is not an authenticated scan; cited books remain leads unless actually read. No proprietary audio is republished.

title: A numerical or historical analogy is not coupling
detail: Focus, beats, EEG, electrical voltage, mechanical modes and location stay separate. The dimensional Planck derivation and photon/Q rebuttal are specifically invalid; broader experiential claims remain unverified.

title: Near-node geometry was clipped to an exact node
detail: The first integrated design module clipped small sine participation to zero. Only explicitly represented exact model nodes are now zeroed; nearby nonnodes retain participation. Column-scaled structural rank still does not measure noisy detectability.

title: Failed storage could retain a stale bridge
status: Fixed and forced-failure browser case passed
detail: A failed dirty-state storage write could leave an older valid model record. Current same-tab/per-tab blocking and run-identity checks reject stale or corrupted bridge records; delayed-hash guards are exercised.

title: Protocol commands omitted required metadata
detail: Current examples include mandatory sidecars and conservative input status. Browser synthetic bundles remain intentionally inadmissible as calibrated force/velocity records.

title: Skill metadata parser silently skipped malformed records
detail: Duplicate JSON keys/IDs, unsupported or missing carrier/beat formats and nonfinite/invalid values require explicit rejection. Pulse/noise entries receive explicit non-carrier-pair status, not a false subtraction check.
